# Agent-Sentinel

> Immutable audit ledger, active governance, and EU AI Act compliance for production AI agents.

Agent-Sentinel is a full-stack governance platform that wraps AI agents with cryptographic accountability. Every agent action is SHA-256 hash-chained into an append-only ledger sealed with ML-DSA-87 post-quantum signatures, giving operators a tamper-evident record compliant with EU AI Act Article 12 (traceability) and Article 14 (human oversight).

## Core capabilities

- **Immutable Audit Ledger** — append-only PostgreSQL table with trigger-enforced immutability; each row incorporates a SHA-256 hash of its data plus the previous row's hash forming a tamper-evident chain.
- **Active Governance (Circuit Breaker)** — pre-flight checks block anomalous or high-risk agent actions before execution; operators approve or reject from the War Room dashboard.
- **OCSF v1.1.0 Telemetry** — all events are schema-validated against the Open Cybersecurity Schema Framework before ingestion.
- **Signal-to-Verdict (S2V) Latency** — median ingestion-to-seal cycle of 11.4 ms at the 99.9th percentile.
- **Intent-Action Consistency Scoring** — ML-based hallucination detection that flags when an agent's stated rationale diverges from its actual action.
- **Per-Tenant Data Isolation** — each Clerk user sees only audit events recorded against their own API key; demo data is physically invisible to signed-in accounts.
- **Compliance Reporting** — one-click PDF export of a signed evidence package for regulatory submission (EU AI Act, SOC 2).
- **Swarm Governance** — register, monitor, and revoke multi-agent swarms with topology visualization.

## Integration (Python SDK)

```python
pip install sentinel-bridge

from sentinel_bridge import Sentinel

sentinel = Sentinel(
    api_key="sk_sent_core_<your-key>",
    base_url="https://agent-sentinel.net",
)

agent = sentinel.register(
    name="my-agent",
    capabilities=["read_email", "summarize"],
)

agent.log_action(
    event_type="TASK_COMPLETE",
    payload={"task": "summarized inbox"},
    rationale="User requested daily summary",
)
```

## Integration (curl / HTTP)

```bash
curl -X POST https://agent-sentinel.net/api/v1/log \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Sentinel-Key: sk_sent_core_<your-key>" \
  -d '{
    "agentId": "my-agent",
    "traceId": "trace-001",
    "eventType": "TASK_COMPLETE",
    "payload": { "task": "hello world" },
    "rationale": "Smoke test"
  }'
```

## Authentication

The dashboard requires a Clerk account. All agent telemetry endpoints accept the `X-Sentinel-Key` header and do not require a Clerk session. The SDK handshake endpoint (`POST /api/v1/auth/verify`) validates a key before starting a run.

## Compliance

- EU AI Act Article 12 — traceability via immutable hash-chained ledger
- EU AI Act Article 14 — human-in-the-loop War Room approval flow
- FIPS-204 — ML-DSA-87 post-quantum signature scheme
- OCSF v1.1.0 — Open Cybersecurity Schema Framework telemetry validation
- SLSA Level 4 integrity grade
